scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev --workspace @greenchimp/api" "npm run dev --workspace @greenchimp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @greenchimp/api && npm run build --workspace @greenchimp/web && node scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @greenchimp/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @greenchimp/web
